items.title: UK banks face temporary corporation tax surcharge rise to 6% under Budget 2026
items.summary: According to The Guardian, chancellor John Healey has announced a temporary increase in the bank corporation tax surcharge, raising it from 3% to 6% for a 15-month period.

items.title: JD Power study shows total loss auto claims weigh on customer satisfaction
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, uS customer satisfaction with total loss claims declined for a third consecutive year, while repairable vehicle claims improved.

items.title: Lawsuit challenges New York state lower minimum wage for tipped workers
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, three former Chili's employees have filed a proposed class action lawsuit in federal court challenging New York's sub-minimum wage for tipped workers.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey delivers first UK budget with temporary bank tax rise
items.summary: According to The Guardian, john Healey has presented his first budget as chancellor, featuring a temporary increase in bank levies alongside cost-of-living and energy measures.

items.title: Spanish high-speed train collision kills at least 64 people south of Madrid
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, a high-speed rail service operated by Renfe collided with an Iryo train south of Madrid, resulting in at least 64 deaths and interrupting key transit lines.

items.title: Dutch government plans AI-led efficiency drive to cut civil service jobs
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, the Netherlands aims to reduce civil servant headcount by 15% to save 3.5 billion euros annually by 2035, prompting international comparisons.
